description.en: The instance ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA).

description.zh:
扩展证书列表。

一次最多支持输入10个证书信息。
description.en:
The list of additional certificates.

You can specify up to 10 certificates at a time.

description.zh:
证书指定生效的域名。一个域名只能绑定一个扩展证书。

一次最多支持输入10个域名。
description.en:
The domain name for which the certificate takes effect. Each domain name can be bound to only one additional certificate.

You can specify up to 10 domain names at a time.

description.zh:
证书ID，当前仅支持服务器证书。

一次最多支持输入10个证书ID。
description.en:
The certificate ID. Only server certificates are supported.

You can specify up to 10 certificate IDs at a time.

description.zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**不一样。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** of each API request is different.

description.zh: 监听实例ID。仅支持HTTPS的监听。
description.en: The instance ID of the listener. Only HTTPS listeners are supported.

description.zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值**cn-hangzhou**。
description.en: The region ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**.

title.en: Bind additional certificates to an HTTPS listener

descriptions.zh:
- 仅HTTPS协议的监听支持绑定扩展证书。
- **AssociateAdditionalCertificatesWithListener**接口属于异步接口，即系统会先返回一个请求ID，但HTTPS监听和扩展证书并未绑定完成，系统后台的关联任务仍在进行。您可以调用[DescribeListener](~~153254~~)查询监听的状态：
    - 当监听处于**updating**状态时，表示HTTPS监听和扩展证书正在绑定中，在该状态下，您只能执行查询操作，不能执行其他操作。
    - 当监听处于**active**状态时，表示HTTPS监听和扩展证书绑定完成。
- **AssociateAdditionalCertificatesWithListener**接口不支持在同一个全球加速实例内并发为HTTPS监听绑定扩展证书。
descriptions.en:
- Only HTTPS protocol listeners support attaching extension certificates.
- The **AssociateAdditionalCertificatesWithListener** operation is asynchronous. After you send a request, the system returns a request ID, but the attachment between the HTTPS listener and the extension certificates is not yet complete because the association node is still running in the background. You can invoke [DescribeListener](~~153254~~) to query the listener status:
    - If the listener is in the **updating** state, the HTTPS listener and extension certificates are being attached. In this state, you can only execute query operations.
    - If the listener is in the **active** state, the HTTPS listener and extension certificates are attached.
- The **AssociateAdditionalCertificatesWithListener** operation does not support concurrent requests to attach extension certificates to HTTPS listeners within the same Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ga associate-additional-certificates-with-listener --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --accelerator-id ga-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --listener-id lsr-bp1bpn0kn908w4nbw0000 --certificates Id=609200-cn-hangzhou Domain=example.com --region cn-hangzhou
